diagnosis: The endpoint launches an audio transcription worker using recordingId directly from route parameters without querying the database to confirm that the audio call recording belongs to req.user.id. Any user can transcribe and inspect confidential customer service call recordings of other accounts.
exploit_request:
POST /api/telephony/recordings/rec_call_908129/transcribe HTTP/1.1
Host: voice.cloudcall.io
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
